description.p: uSimmics, formerly QucsStudio, is a circuit simulator with schematic capture, simulation, and tools for analyzing electronic circuits.

This community package downloads the official Windows archive and runs it using Wine and a private persistent Cellar prefix. Wine is a separate dependency: install it with flatpak install flathub org.winehq.Wine//stable-26.08.
Microstrip simulations may fail under Wine because of the Microsoft Visual C++ runtime DLLs. See the upstream FAQ for details. Hardware access has not been tested with this package.

Your Documents folder is available on drive H: for circuits and simulation output. To use another folder, run flatpak override --user --filesystem=/path/to/circuits de.qucsstudio.uSimmics. Undo permissions with flatpak override --user --reset de.qucsstudio.uSimmics.
The interface follows your desktop scale by default. If the text or controls are too small, choose a larger size. Restart uSimmics after changing the setting.

ul.li: Example for larger text and controls: flatpak run --command=cellar de.qucsstudio.uSimmics config dpi=168
Restore automatic scaling: flatpak run --command=cellar de.qucsstudio.uSimmics config dpi=auto
